verse: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verse_spoken: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it?
I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning with the places where I feel stuck.
You are the God who makes a way where there seems to be no way.
Where I have prayed and waited for so long, let your answer spring forth.
Break every chain that holds me back, and every fear that keeps me small.
Where my life feels like a desert, let your rivers flow again.
Give me eyes to see the new thing you are already doing.
Give me courage to step through the doors you open, and patience while you work.
Let me trust your timing, even before I see the breakthrough.
Let everyone praying with me see your hand move in their lives today.
